quarterly_data.quarter: BASF press release: BASF strengthens its position in the market and achieves major progress (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: BASF (release): Q2 2026 sales were EUR 17.2 billion, EUR 2.4 billion above the prior-year period, on prices up 11.5% and volumes up 7.3%; EBITDA before special items rose by EUR 854 million to EUR 2.4 billion; net income was EUR 4.1 billion including a EUR 3.5 billion after-tax gain from the sale of the Coatings business to Carlyle; H1 2026 sales were EUR 33.2 billion and EBITDA before special items EUR 4.8 billion; H1 free cash flow was minus EUR 1.6 billion.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 sales EUR 17.2 billion; EBITDA before special items EUR 2.4 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: BASF press release: BASF strengthens its position in the market and achieves major progress (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: BASF (release): FY2026 outlook raised to EBITDA before special items of EUR 6.9 billion to EUR 7.7 billion (previously EUR 6.2 billion to EUR 7.0 billion), with free cash flow of EUR 1.5 billion to EUR 2.3 billion unchanged, assuming an average Brent oil price of $80 per barrel (previously $65) and chemical production growth of 1.8% (previously 2.4%).
quarterly_data.figure: FY2026 EBITDA before special items EUR 6.9 billion to EUR 7.7 billion

quarterly_data.quarter: BASF press release: BASF strengthens its position in the market and achieves major progress (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: CEO Markus Kamieth (release): BASF reduced costs, lowered capital expenditures, increased plant capacity utilization and ramped up the new Zhanjiang Verbund site; from January 2024 to end-June 2026 it cut around 7,000 employees worldwide, and in May 2026 full-time equivalents at BASF SE in Ludwigshafen fell below 30,000 for the first time since 1954; the share of highly competitive production units at Ludwigshafen rose from 78% to 88% since 2024.
quarterly_data.figure: around 7,000 positions reduced since January 2024; Ludwigshafen highly competitive units 88%
